defects: Replaces general scalar multiplication (SMul α β, a : α acting on β via •) with plain ring/monoid multiplication (Mul M₀, a : M₀ acting on M₀ via *), collapsing the scalar type and the codomain type into a single type M₀ — this drops the generality of the gold statement, which allows the scalars (type α) and the target (type β) to be different structures related only by a PosSMulMono instance
Uses PosMulMono M₀ instead of PosSMulMono α β, which is a strictly more specific typeclass assumption (only covers the self-action case β = α via Mul.toSMul, not arbitrary SMul actions)
Conclusion is stated with a * f x instead of a • f x, i.e. only proves the multiplicative specialization rather than the general scalar-multiplication statement
